about: Brief 108 review F1: the cooled room (104_cooled_room_spec.json) with its heated rooms heated by hot-water radiators whose output follows the room. Flow 50 C, design return 40 C, rooms at their 20 C setpoint; each room's emitter gives 'design_output_w' there. Exponent 1 and radiant share 0, so EnergyPlus's ZoneHVAC:Baseboard:RadiantConvective:Water (effectiveness-NTU at a fixed UA, all convective) and Engine 2's EN 442 radiator at constant water flow are the same kind of curve: output in proportion to (flow temperature - room air temperature). EnergyPlus's rating inputs are derived from these figures by its documented sizing (Engineering Reference 15.4.3.3), before any comparison; the referee then measures the proportion EnergyPlus actually ran with. 'tight' and 'mild' are the caps of 108_capped_spec.json, now at the setpoint only.
